Green Lantern Corps

Ash

A Lantern whose stories turn toward horror.

Ash is a Green Lantern whose stories bring horror into the Corps’ wider science-fiction setting. His later assignment intersects with the approach of Blackest Night.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Green Lantern Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern Corps Quarterly #7 (Winter 1993), “Ashes to Ashes”
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Ashel Sabian Formata begins as a farmer from Arata whose wife is killed by vampires. His subsequent Lantern career returns to horror when Scar sends him to search for the Anti-Monitor. He meets Saarek, and their discoveries lead toward the Black Lantern threat. The secondary chronology identifies Green Lantern #42 for this later chapter and notes that their deaths are not fully shown.

Key Stories

  • Agent Orange finale
    Green Lantern #42 (2009), Blackest Night setup

Reading order

  • Blackest Night
